notes: Coverage is partial: only clinics with an own website that could be opened are listed (21 entries, 10 with explicit 24 h wording). No duty rota (garde) pages and no veterinary poison line were found; the Centre Anti Poison et de Pharmacovigilance du Maroc (CAPM) serves humans and was not used. Not covered: Tétouan, Oujda, Dakhla, Salé, Settat, Taghazout, Tanger beyond Gibraltar (only aggregator or Facebook listings found). Leads claiming 24 h only on aggregators (not verified on own site): Harhoura, Sidate Témara, Cabinet Témara Excellence, Les Oudayas Témara, ERRAHMA Rabat, V.I.Pet Casablanca, Beauséjour Casablanca, INES Marrakech, Settat, Nasma Fès, Duovet Tanger. Also unreached: IAV Hassan II hospital page, Clinique Vétérinaire Casa-Anfa, Dr Chakroune, Malak (Rabat). Eurolia (clinique-veterinaire-eurolia.com) is in France and was discarded.
